title: Blanket go get -u used to resolve one finding
code_snippet:
# Response to a finding in golang.org/x/net:
$ go get -u ./...
# 47 modules upgraded; three carry breaking changes; CI red on unrelated packages
violated_rule: `go get -u` upgrades far more than the target
expected_feedback: go get -u raises the named target and everything beneath it; go get -u ./... does so for the whole build list. Use the named form, go get golang.org/x/net@v0.17.0, then diff go.mod to see what minimal version selection moved in response — even a named upgrade re-solves the graph, so 'targeted' means targeted intent, not a one-line diff.
coverage_rules: `go get -u` upgrades far more than the target
